=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: p.stonn has not been able to sign in to the council for over an hour
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

p.stonn's sign-in to the council expired, and it has not been able to sign back in for over an hour. Until p.stonn can sign in, none of the changes on your schedule will happen.

If a different rego needs to be on the permit, please change it yourself on the council website now. Otherwise the car parked there is not covered and could be fined.

p.stonn will keep trying, and your schedule will carry on by itself once the council accepts the sign-in. If you need to link your council account again, we will email you.

Council portal: https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/ssp/
Open p.stonn: https://p.stonn.org
